workflow.name: Nightly Governance Validation
workflow.goal: Review repository governance state, classify deltas, analyze duplicates, and publish a human-reviewable daily report.

agents.name: Data Ingestion
agents.role: Load manifest, repository visibility, and governance files

agents.name: Schema Validator
agents.role: Validate required files, enums, and report structure

agents.name: Data Transformer
agents.role: Normalize repository deltas and proposed manifest rows

agents.name: DB Agent
agents.role: Persist reviewed governance state when approved

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.role: Check evidence quality and non-destructive safety gates

agents.name: Report Generator
agents.role: Create daily governance report from template

agents.name: Notifier
agents.role: Notify human reviewer when approval is required

agents.name: Logger
agents.role: Append audit trail and decision log entries
